shortDescription.default: CRM for SharePoint and Teams: leads, deals, quotes, invoices, cases, forecasts.

longDescription.default: Brillienta CRM is a complete CRM that runs inside SharePoint Online and Microsoft Teams. All data stays in SharePoint lists on your own site, protected by your Microsoft 365 permissions. Sales: leads with scoring, duplicate checks and round-robin assignment; accounts and contacts with a 360 view; a drag-and-drop pipeline with AI deal health; forecasting against quotas; products, price books and branded quotes with discount approval and e-signature. Billing: subscriptions with MRR and ARR and automatic renewal opportunities, invoices with Razorpay or Stripe payment links, and export to Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero and Tally. Marketing: demo requests with Teams meetings, campaigns with ROI, email campaigns and follow-up sequences. Service: cases with business-hours SLAs, a knowledge base, a customer portal and satisfaction surveys. Also included: Outlook email and automatic logging, Teams channel alerts, WhatsApp, a Power Automate flow pack, webhooks and an inbound API, Power BI, CSV import and export, role-based and record-level security, an audit log and GDPR tools. The optional Brillienta CRM Copilot add-on shows your pipeline, accounts, renewals, overdue invoices and SLA risks in Microsoft 365 Copilot. Includes a 30-day free trial of every feature; after the trial a licence key from Brillienta is required (Standard or Enterprise). Microsoft Graph permissions: Mail.Send, Mail.Read and Calendars.ReadWrite are used only for Outlook email, Outlook logging and Teams meetings, and User.ReadBasic.All for people search; the CRM works without them. Get started: start your free 30-day trial at https://brillienta.com/crm. Help: read the product guide at https://brillienta.com/guides/crm/. Contact us: https://brillienta.com/contact or support@brillienta.com.
